title: Index daemon rejects config that validates in-process
description:
## Problem

`kbs standup` and issue listing fail with `unknown configuration fields` when the daemon answers `index.list`, while the same `.kanbus.yml` validates via `ProjectConfiguration.model_validate`. Workaround: `KANBUS_NO_DAEMON=1`.

## Root cause

Stale daemon process from an older binary cannot parse newer config schema fields.

## Fix

Daemon reload/restart on config schema changes and automatic failover to filesystem listing so users never need `KANBUS_NO_DAEMON` for this.

## Acceptance

From Kanbus repo root, `kbs standup` works without `KANBUS_NO_DAEMON`.
